description: Two synthetic text probes per conversation language: antonym selection and short reasoning over a count that changes. Each expected group must match at least one answer variant. This checks constrained task success; it is not a measure of general fluency.

en.prompt: What is the opposite of “hot” when talking about temperature? Reply with one word.
Maya has 2 apples. She buys 3 more and gives 1 to a friend. How many apples does Maya have now? Answer in one short sentence.

sq.prompt: Cila është e kundërta e fjalës «i nxehtë» kur flasim për temperaturën? Përgjigju me një fjalë.

ar.prompt: ما عكس كلمة «حارّ» عند الحديث عن درجة الحرارة؟ أجب بكلمة واحدة.
